commit.message: feat(dcp): evidence-pack subcommand, receipt hash-locking in PROOF.json

pr.title: feat(dcp): evidence-pack + receipt hash-locking (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-108)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds `dopemux dcp evidence-pack <tp>` subcommand: assembles proof/<tp>/, collects receipts from .dcp/ store into proof/<tp>/receipts/, emits a DCP snapshot, and produces a red-lane report.
- PROOF.json schema gains additive optional `receipt_refs[]` field — array of `{path, sha256}` anchoring each collected receipt into the committed proof bundle.
- `dcp verify-proof` updated to validate receipt hashes from `receipt_refs` when present.
- Tamper test: modifying a collected receipt after hash-lock causes verify-proof to report TAMPERED.
- Backward compatibility: existing 30+ committed proof bundles verified against both proof.py and scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py — all must pass.

## Validation
- Pack → verify round-trip passes.
- Tamper test confirms modified receipt is detected.
- Old bundles green on both validator paths.

## NOT_RUN
- L3 completeness gate requiring receipts in evidence (Wave 4).

steps.task: Preflight: enumerate existing committed proof bundles under proof/, verify both validator paths are importable, confirm PROOF.json schema does not currently have receipt_refs, and read scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py to understand its validation contract.
commands: python -m py_compile scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py && echo 'validate_audit_proof ok' || echo 'MISSING'
python -m json.tool schemas/proof/proof_schema.json | grep -c 'receipt_refs' || echo '0 - field absent as expected'
validation: List of existing proof bundles recorded.
receipt_refs confirmed absent from current schema (additive change).

steps.task: Extend PROOF.json schema (schemas/proof/proof_schema.json) with an additive optional receipt_refs field: array of objects {path: string, sha256: string}. The field is optional so all existing bundles without it remain valid. Update proof.py to populate and validate this field when present.
validation: Existing PROOF.json bundles without receipt_refs still validate against the updated schema.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/dcp/evidence_pack.py: (1) discover .dcp/receipts/<session>/ files relevant to a TP run; (2) copy them to proof/<tp>/receipts/; (3) compute sha256 of each collected receipt file; (4) write receipt_refs[{path, sha256}] into PROOF.json; (5) emit a DCP control snapshot and red-lane report into proof/<tp>/. Add dcp evidence-pack <tp> subcommand to cli_dcp.py.

Implement tamper detection: after evidence-pack produces a PROOF.json with receipt_refs, modify one collected receipt file on disk and run dcp verify-proof — confirm it exits non-zero and reports TAMPERED for the modified receipt.
validation: dcp verify-proof output contains 'TAMPERED' or 'hash mismatch' string when receipt is modified.

steps.task: Backward-compatibility sweep: run both validators against all existing committed proof bundles. Use both proof.py validate_proof_file() and scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py — all 30+ bundles must pass both paths with the updated schema.
commands: find proof -name 'PROOF.json' -exec python -c "import sys; from dopemux.dcp.proof import validate_proof_file; validate_proof_file(sys.argv[1]); print('PASS', sys.argv[1])" {} \;
validation: All existing PROOF.json bundles PASS proof.py validate_proof_file().
All existing PROOF.json bundles PASS scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py.

steps.task: Run full evidence-pack test suite, write proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-108/PROOF.json with PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN buckets, confirm diff scope inside allowlist.
validation: git diff --name-only HEAD confirms only allowlist files changed.
Auditor identity differs from implementer in PROOF.json.
